children: HCL Technologies Limited (NSE:HCLTECH) beat expectations in Q2 FY27 with Rs35,620cr revenue and Rs5,132cr profit, lifted margins and AI revenue of $219M as it wins multiple AI/cloud deals, raises guidance and forecasts, plans $365M data‑center capex, and declared an Rs12 interim dividend.
Previous Week Recap
HCLTECH Q2 FY27 Revenue, Profit, Margin
: HCLTECH Q2 FY27: revenue Rs35,620cr (+11.5% YoY, +3% QoQ), net profit Rs5,132cr (+21% YoY), margin 18.2% (+131bps), AI revenue $219M, net new deals ~$3.25B, interim dividend Rs12.
HCLTECH Wins AI And Cloud Deals
: HCLTECH won multiple client deals for AI and cloud: AI-native US firm, neocloud provider, European manufacturer (VisionX QA), European FMCG (AI IT ops), plus Fortune Global 50 SAP/S4HANA work
HCL Technologies Plans Data Centers Investment
: HCL Technologies plans a $365 million investment to build and operate data centers totaling up to 50MW to address capacity constraints.
HCL Technologies Interim Dividend Declaration
: HCL Technologies (HCLTECH) declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share (face value Rs 2). Record date: October 16, 2026. Payment date: October 26, 2026.
DAM Capital Raises HCLTECH Forecasts
: DAM Capital raised HCL Technologies (HCLTECH) earnings forecasts after HCLTech upgraded guidance; other brokers also revised estimates following HCLTech’s better-than-expected margins.
HCL Technologies Slower Q2 Revenue
: HCL Technologies (HCLTECH) said weaker software product demand slowed Q2 revenue growth, with management citing reduced product sales as a key factor.
Kotak Sees HCLTECH Revenue Trim
: Kotak Institutional sees HCLTECH trimming quarterly revenue guidance to 3–4% as Guardian Life ramps and a €1bn mega deal closes; TCV tied to these deals ~$3.75bn.
Anand Rathi Upgrades HCL Technologies
: Anand Rathi upgraded HCL Technologies to BUY after Q2 FY27: revenue +2.3% QoQ (1.3% organic), AI-related revenue $219M, up 28.4% sequentially and 78% YoY.
HCL Technologies AI Price-Cuts Strategy
: HCL Technologies says AI-driven price cuts in traditional IT are early. Management aims to win share in core services and expand advanced AI products and services.
HCLTECH Headcount Records And Clients
: HCLTECH headcount hit a record 230,339 on Sept 30, up 6,450 in the quarter. Clients with USD 50M+ rose to 62; added 33 new USD 10M+ clients.
